# Santec.Library C ABI reference

<!-- Generated by tools/generate_abi_reference.py from SantecLibrary/SantecLibrary.h.
     Do not edit by hand: run the tool, or the release check will fail. -->

189 entry points. Every one is `[UnmanagedCallersOnly]` in the managed
implementation and exported from `Santec.Library.dll` by name.

## Rules that apply to every entry point

**Threading.** None of these calls is thread-safe. The device cache, the parameter
builders and the cached scan results are shared mutable state, so call them from one
thread at a time: normally the thread that owns the instruments. Concurrent calls can
corrupt a scan or return another caller's data.

**Memory.** Calls that return data allocate it with the library's own allocator. Free it
with the function named in that entry's documentation, never with `free()` and never by
reaching into the returned structure. The index at the end of this document lists them.

**Errors.** Nothing throws. On failure an entry point returns its documented sentinel
(`false`, `0`, `NaN`, a null pointer, or nothing written) and logs to
`%APPDATA%\Santec\SantecLibrary\logs`. There is no error-query entry point in this
version; check that log.

**Strings.** Parameters documented as UTF-8 are null-terminated `char*`. Strings the
library returns are UTF-8. `ConnectionConfig` is the exception: its members are marshalled
with the platform default (ANSI on Windows), which matters only for non-ASCII device names.

**Platform.** Windows x64. `SIMULATION` builds (development only) report mock instruments.

## Tunable laser (TSL)

Compiled in when `SANTEC_INCLUDE_TSL` is defined; the published DLL defines all of them.

### `GetTSLPower`

```c
double GetTSLPower(void);
```

Reads the TSL output power.

**Returns** Power in dBm or mW depending on the active power mode,

> or NaN if no device is connected.

### `SetTSLPower`

```c
void SetTSLPower(double power);
```

Sets the TSL output power. Interpreted as mW or dBm based on the active power mode. Use GetTSLPowerMode() / SetTSLPowerMode() to switch.

| Parameter | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `power` | Desired power level. |

### `WaitTSLForSweepStatus`

```c
int32_t WaitTSLForSweepStatus(int32_t waitTime, int32_t status, int32_t notEqual);
```

Waits until the sweep reaches one of the given statuses.

| Parameter | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `waitTime` | Milliseconds to wait before giving up. |
| `status` | Status to wait for. |
| `notEqual` | Non-zero to wait until the status is anything but `status`. |

**Returns** 1 when the status was reached, 0 on timeout or when no device is connected.

```c

```

```c

```

| Parameter | Meaning |

### `ReadOPMBulkPowers`

```c
void ReadOPMBulkPowers(const char* serialNumberPtr, double** data, int32_t* length, uint8_t* channelCount);
```

Bulk-reads the power samples of every channel of an OPM-150. The device captures OPM_BULK_SAMPLES_PER_CHANNEL samples of each channel and converts them to dBm. Values are channel-major: data[channelIndex * OPM_BULK_SAMPLES_PER_CHANNEL + sampleIndex] Bulk read requires a USB (FTDI) connection and an averaging level of 4, and is unavailable over the OP-ETH module. A sample is NaN when it could not be read: the connection is not USB, the active wavelength is unknown, or the sample was out of range. The library allocates the buffer. Free it with FreeOPMBulkPowers().

| Parameter | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `serialNumberPtr` | Serial number (null-terminated). |
| `data` | Receives the power samples in dBm (NULL on failure). |
| `length` | Receives the number of doubles, that is |
| `channelCount` | Receives the number of channels the buffer holds, |

> channelCount * OPM_BULK_SAMPLES_PER_CHANNEL

> (0 on failure).

> at most OPM_BULK_MAX_CHANNELS (0 on failure).

### `FreeOPMBulkPowers`

```c
void FreeOPMBulkPowers(double* data);
```

Frees memory allocated by ReadOPMBulkPowers().

| Parameter | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `data` | Pointer to free. NULL is safe. |

### `SetOPMAveraging`


Sets the averaging level for all channels on an OPM-150. Requires special firmware. Only works over USB (FTDI); the command is not sent over Ethernet.

### `GetOPMAveraging`

```c

```

Gets the averaging level from an OPM-150. Returns the value last passed to SetOPMAveraging(). Over Ethernet this cached value may differ from the device's actual setting, since the set command is USB-only.

| Parameter | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `serialNumberPtr` | Serial number (null-terminated). |

**Returns** Averaging level (0 to 4, where 4 is fastest),

> or 0xFF if the device is not found.

### `SetOPMReadValidation`

```c
void SetOPMReadValidation(const char* serialNumberPtr, uint8_t enable);
```

Enables or disables read validation on an OPM-150. When enabled, the device reads all channels three times per call and validates the readings against the threshold from SetOPMReadMaxDeltaDb().

| Parameter | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `serialNumberPtr` | Serial number (null-terminated). |
| `enable` | Non-zero to enable, zero to disable. A single byte, |

> matching the managed entry point.

### `GetOPMReadValidation`

```c

```

Gets the read validation setting from an OPM-150.

| Parameter | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `serialNumberPtr` | Serial number (null-terminated). |

**Returns** 1 if enabled, 0 if disabled, -1 if not found.

### `SetOPMReadMaxDeltaDb`

```c
void SetOPMReadMaxDeltaDb(const char* serialNumberPtr, double maxDeltaDb);
```

Sets the read validation max delta threshold on an OPM-150. When a channel reading differs from the other two by more than this value (in dB), the device logs a warning during read validation. Default is 0.5 dB. Must be greater than zero.

| Parameter | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `serialNumberPtr` | Serial number (null-terminated). |
| `maxDeltaDb` | Threshold in dB. |

### `GetOPMReadMaxDeltaDb`

```c
double GetOPMReadMaxDeltaDb(const char* serialNumberPtr);
```

Gets the read validation maximum delta threshold from an OPM-150.

| Parameter | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `serialNumberPtr` | Serial number (null-terminated). |

**Returns** Maximum delta threshold (dB),

> or NaN if the device is not found.

### `ValidateParameters`


## OPM-150 network configuration

Compiled in when `SANTEC_INCLUDE_OPM_NETWORK` is defined; the published DLL defines all of them.

### `DiscoverOPMDevices`

```c
char* DiscoverOPMDevices(void);
```

Discovers OPM-150 devices on the network via GIPA broadcast. The library allocates the returned string. Free it with FreeString().

**Returns** Discovery responses (one per line, UTF-8), or NULL if none respond.

### `SetOPMNetworkConfig`

```c
char* SetOPMNetworkConfig(const char* macAddressPtr, const char* ipAddressPtr, const char* maskPtr);
```

Sets the IP address and netmask of an OPM-150 via SIPA broadcast. Pass "0.0.0.0" for the IP to enable DHCP. The library allocates the returned string. Free it with FreeString().

| Parameter | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `macAddressPtr` | MAC address ("00-00-5E-00-53-00"). |
| `ipAddressPtr` | IP address, or "0.0.0.0" for DHCP. |
| `maskPtr` | Netmask ("255.255.255.0"). |

**Returns** Device response (UTF-8), or NULL on error.

### `QueryOPMTempConfig`

```c
char* QueryOPMTempConfig(void);
```

Queries temporary IP config from all OPM-150 devices via TIPA broadcast. The library allocates the returned string. Free it with FreeString().

**Returns** TIPA responses (one per line, UTF-8), or NULL if none respond.

### `ApplyOPMNetworkConfig`

```c
char* ApplyOPMNetworkConfig(const char* macAddressPtr);
```

Commits the temporary IP configuration to flash via UIPC broadcast. The library allocates the returned string. Free it with FreeString().

| Parameter | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `macAddressPtr` | MAC address ("00-00-5E-00-53-00"). |

**Returns** Device response (UTF-8), or NULL on error.

### `ClearDiscoveredOPMNics`

```c
void ClearDiscoveredOPMNics(void);
```

Clears the cached network interfaces. After calling this, SetOPMNetworkConfig(), QueryOPMTempConfig(), and ApplyOPMNetworkConfig() will require a fresh DiscoverOPMDevices() call.

## IL / PDL calculation

Compiled in when `SANTEC_INCLUDE_PDL_CALCULATION` is defined; the published DLL defines all of them.

### `Calculation`

```c
void Calculation( NominalWavelength nominalWavelength, PowerData referenceData, PowerData measurementData, PowerData referencePowerMonitorData, PowerData measurementPowerMonitorData, double* il, double* pdl);
```

Calculates insertion loss and polarization-dependent loss. Uses the four-SOP Jones-matrix method (LHP, LVP, LP45, LCP) via the connected PCU110.

| Parameter | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `nominalWavelength` | Nominal wavelength band. |
| `referenceData` | Reference scan power readings. |
| `measurementData` | Measurement scan power readings. |
| `referencePowerMonitorData` | Reference scan monitor readings. |
| `measurementPowerMonitorData` | Measurement scan monitor readings. |
| `il` | Receives the insertion loss (dB). |
| `pdl` | Receives the polarization-dependent loss (dB). |

## Core: logging, discovery, connection and memory

### `SetLogLevel`


Sets the minimum log level threshold.

| Parameter | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `level` | Only events at this level or higher are logged. |


```c
void EnableVerbose(void);
```

Enables verbose-level logging.

### `GetDeviceNum`

```c
int32_t GetDeviceNum(void);
```

Returns the number of connected devices.

**Returns** Device count, or 0 if none are detected.

### `GetDevices`

```c
int32_t GetDevices(void* devices, int32_t capacity);
```

Writes device connection configurations into a caller-supplied buffer. Pass the count from GetDeviceNum() as the capacity. At most `capacity` entries are written and never more than the device count, so a device that appears between the two calls cannot overrun the buffer. The strings inside the written structures are allocated by the library: call FreeConnectionConfigs() with the returned count before reusing or freeing the buffer. The buffer itself belongs to the caller.

| Parameter | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `devices` | Buffer that receives the ConnectionConfig array. |
| `capacity` | Number of ConnectionConfig entries the buffer can hold. |

**Returns** Number of entries written.

### `FreeConnectionConfigs`

```c
void FreeConnectionConfigs(ConnectionConfig* devices, int32_t count);
```

Releases the strings that GetDevices() wrote into a caller's buffer. Does not free the buffer itself. Safe to call with a null pointer or a non-positive count.

| Parameter | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `devices` | Buffer filled by GetDevices(). |
| `count` | Entry count returned by GetDevices(). |


Connects to a device.

| `devPtr` | ConnectionConfig for the target device. |

**Returns** true on success.

### `SetConnections`

```c
bool SetConnections(void* tslPtr, void* mpmPtr, void* spuPtr);
```

Connects to a TSL, Power Meter, and optionally a DAQ device. When `spuPtr` is NULL, only the TSL and Power Meter connections are made.

| Parameter | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `tslPtr` | ConnectionConfig for the TSL device. |
| `mpmPtr` | ConnectionConfig for the Power Meter. |
| `spuPtr` | ConnectionConfig for the DAQ device, or NULL. |

**Returns** true when all required connections succeed.


Disconnects and releases all resources.

```c

```

Sets the wavelength on the TSL and all connected OPM-150 devices.

| Parameter | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `wavelength` | Nominal wavelength band. |

### `FreeArrayData`

```c
void FreeArrayData(void* data);
```

Frees memory allocated by array-returning functions.

| Parameter | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `data` | Pointer to free. NULL is safe. |

### `FreeString`

```c
void FreeString(void* str);
```

Frees a string returned by the library. Covers DiscoverOPMDevices, SetOPMNetworkConfig, QueryOPMTempConfig, ApplyOPMNetworkConfig, ValidateParameters and GetLibraryVersion.

| Parameter | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `str` | Pointer to free. NULL is safe. |

### `GetLibraryVersion`

```c
char* GetLibraryVersion(void);
```

Returns the library version as a UTF-8 string. Lets a caller identify the binary it loaded without reading the file's version resource. Free the result with FreeString().

**Returns** Version string, or NULL if it could not be produced.

## Entry points that return memory

| Entry point | Free with |
|---|---|
| `GetDevices` | `FreeConnectionConfigs` |
| `ReferenceScan` | `FreeArrayData` |
| `MeasurementScan` | `FreeArrayData` |
| `ValidateParameters` | `FreeString` |
| `GetMPMModulePower` | `FreeArrayData` |
| `GetMPMInfo` | `FreeArrayData` |
| `ReadOPMAllChannels` | `FreeAllChannelsRead` |
| `DiscoverOPMDevices` | `FreeString` |
| `SetOPMNetworkConfig` | `FreeString` |
| `QueryOPMTempConfig` | `FreeString` |
| `ApplyOPMNetworkConfig` | `FreeString` |
| `GetLibraryVersion` | `FreeString` |

`FreeConnectionConfigs` releases the strings inside a caller-owned `ConnectionConfig`
array; it does not free the array itself.
